question: What is the function of the yellow change interval, how is its duration established, and may a pre-yellow vehicular countdown display be used?
model_answer: Direct Answer: The exclusive function of the yellow change interval is to warn approaching traffic that their permission to proceed is being terminated, after which they will be directed to stop (or, for a protected/permissive turn, that the protected movement is ending). Its duration must be determined using engineering practices, with a recommended range of 3 to 6 seconds in the hybrid beacon context, longer values reserved for higher-speed approaches. The evidence provided contains no provisions addressing pre-yellow vehicular countdown displays, so that part of the question cannot be answered from this evidence. Standards (mandatory): - "The duration of the yellow change interval shall be determined using engineering practices." - For pedestrian hybrid beacons: "The duration of the steady yellow change interval shall be determined using engineering practices in accordance with the provisions in Section 4F.17." - For emergency-vehicle hybrid beacons: "The duration of the steady yellow change interval shall be determined using engineering practices in accordance with the provisions in Section 4F.17." Guidance (recommended): - For emergency-vehicle hybrid beacons, a yellow change interval should have a minimum duration of 3 seconds and a maximum duration of 6 seconds, with the longer intervals reserved for use on approaches with higher speeds. Citations: - Section 4F.17 Support §1 (p.708) - Section 4F.17 Standard §3 (p.708) - Section 4H.11 Support §3 (p.717) - Section 4J.03 Standard §10 (p.730) - Section 4N.03 Standard §4 (p.743) - Section 4N.03 Guidance §5 (p.743) Note: Support provisions (explanatory only) describe the interval's function — warning traffic that permission to proceed is terminating — and clarify that providing clearance time through the intersection is the purpose of the red clearance interval, not the yellow change interval. No provision in the supplied evidence addresses whether a pre-yellow vehicular countdown display may be used; the evidence is insufficient on that point.
gold_answer: The yellow change interval warns that permission to proceed or a protected movement is ending. Its duration must be determined using engineering practices, with guidance of 3 to 6 seconds. Pre-yellow displays such as vehicular countdowns or flashing green indications are prohibited, except for permitted advance-warning beacons.
